devTools.title: Developer tools
devTools.description: M4 reminder proof of concept. These screens are available in the dev flavor only.

test.title: Reminder test lab
test.subtitle: Schedule real alarms and notifications. SQLite is the source of truth.
test.settingsOpened: Settings opened. Return here to refresh state.
test.empty: No reminders are stored. Schedule one to test delivery.
test.confirmClearMessage: This removes the SQLite rows and cancels every cached alarm.
test.confirmStressMessage: The native layer schedules 200 and reports the 5 overflow reminders.

diagnostics.title: Reminder diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Dev-only view of native cache, alarms, permissions, and the action queue.
diagnostics.extraInCache: Cache rows not active in SQLite

issues.notificationsNotDetermined: Notification permission has not been requested. Allow notifications before testing delivery.
issues.notificationsDenied: Notification permission is denied. Open notification settings and allow reminders.
issues.appNotificationsDisabled: Notifications are disabled for this app. Enable them in Android settings.
issues.channelBlocked: The task_reminders channel is blocked. Raise its importance or recreate it.
issues.channelMissing: The task_reminders channel has not been created yet. It is created on the next reconcile.
issues.exactAlarmDenied: Exact alarms are denied. Reminders fall back to inexact alarms and may be delayed.
issues.pendingAlarmCap: More than 200 reminders are active. Later reminders are deferred until slots free up.
issues.alarmScheduleErrors: One or more alarms could not be registered. Reconcile and inspect logcat.
issues.deliveryBlocked: A reminder fired while notifications were blocked. Grant access and reconcile.
issues.pendingNativeActions: Notification actions are waiting to be applied to SQLite. Reconcile to drain them.
issues.batterySaverActive: Battery saver is on. Allow-while-idle alarms still fire, but delivery can be delayed.
issues.deviceIdleActive: The device is in Doze. Exact allow-while-idle alarms are the best available delivery.
issues.batteryOptimizationAllowed: Battery optimization is allowed. M4 does not request an exemption; delivery can be delayed.
issues.cacheDrift: The native cache and SQLite disagree. Reconcile to rebuild the cache from SQLite.

errorBoundary.title: Nova Task hit a problem
errorBoundary.description: Your data has not been changed. Restart the app to continue.
errorBoundary.restartHint: Resets the interface after an unexpected error
